BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to equipment placed in vehicle interiors; andadding a new section to chapter 46.37 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.37 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Objects that are not original vehicle equipment and areinstalled in the passenger compartment of a vehicle must be securelyfastened in place. (2) When there are one or more passengers in the backseat of avehicle, an object weighing more than one pound may not be placed onthe back shelf behind the passenger seats unless the object is securelyfastened in place. (3) Enforcement of this section by law enforcement officers may beaccomplished only as a secondary action when a driver of a motorvehicle has been detained for a suspected violation of this title or anequivalent local ordinance or some other offense.
